integrity: Exact Gram and normal identities were checked against finite rational examples; proof of the universal statement is analytic. No independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact finite real-Hilbert terminal-width result only; no complex, arbitrary order, strong NP-hardness, inapproximability, or attractor application claimed. Unresolved possibility of implicit coverage by older general matrix-width theory.
title: Fixed-angle equiangular Kolmogorov widths and the number-partition threshold
